about_the_game: All the boss fights and progression you love from Terraria put into a completely new 3D environment. This game is a passion project from someone who has always wanted to see terraria brought into the 3D realm. All your favorite bosses, enemies, and items brought into a completely new dimension.
detailed_description: All the boss fights and progression you love from Terraria put into a completely new 3D environment. This game is a passion project from someone who has always wanted to see terraria brought into the 3D realm. All your favorite bosses, enemies, and items brought into a completely new dimension.
name: Terraria 3D

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: 2nd Gen Intel core processor or equivalent from AMD
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Gtx 600 series or equivalent AMD card
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: 4th Gen Intel core processor or equivalent from AMD
  • Graphics: gtx 750ti or newer
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space

short_description: The same game you know and love brought into the third dimension. Completely new gameplay while keeping the original enemies, items, and progression of Terraria.
